# Synthetic club website (test fixture)

**Fictional.** Hand-written pages for a made-up organization ("Example Robotics Collective", `example-robotics.test`) used to exercise the crawler, the document normalizer and the deterministic/LLM extractors end to end. It includes deliberate traps: a member bio, a cookie banner, nav chrome, an institutional social account, an individual's email, a stale deadline, and a selectivity number with no term.
